title: NoSQLServer columnar virtual table candidate v0.93
summary: Draft PR #141 adds an opt-in columnar shadow over existing storage backends; dev1 introduces sparse segment reads and ROW/COLUMN/AUTO selection while keeping row authority for DML. This is a development candidate, not a release.
invariants: Logical SQL relation, schema, and typed row semantics stay independent of physical storage layout.
Memory-port ooRexx r13196 isolated test passes: 9 segment reads versus 16 dev0 in a one-row/128-row narrow query; this is not a latency benchmark.
ROW mode requires a row source; COLUMN requires a published shadow; AUTO favors indexed PK row lookups and wide row projections.
Memory generation CAS and failed write retention are tested; real SQLPort durability, WAL, multi-writer publication and orphan cleanup are unqualified.
No prod migration, full SQL regression, crash recovery, timed benchmark or deployment is claimed.

provenance.claim: Isolated PASS with explicit unrun gates.
